text:
maria: Quick non-work poll — what's the best sticker on your laptop right now? pics encouraged :camera_with_flash: 

alex: tiny T-Rex wearing headphones sticker. Someone gave it to me at the retreat, still holding strong :dino: 

sam: @alex that sounds iconic. Mine is a hand-drawn blue planet with a tiny coffee cup orbiting it. Coffee forever ☕🌍 

jen: I have a faded 'I love cryptic regex' sticker from 2018 that I refuse to replace. It glows at night (kinda) :laughing: 

kai: no pics but a scratch-off vinyl sticker where you can scratch off to reveal a motivational quote. Always fun during deploy days :sweat_smile: 

alex: ok here's the T-Rex — https://imgur.com/a/FAKE123 (posted for dramatic effect, no pressure to click)

maria: love it. also curious: would anyone be down for a sticker-swap mailer? small pack, random picks, international ok? :mailbox_with_mail: 

sam: 100% yes. I will trade you my coffee-planet for jen's regex sticker :raised_hands: 

jen: deal. jen -> sam, sam -> jen. alex, kai, maria: who wants in?

kai: count me in. i have a weird collection of pun stickers. tradeable.

sticker-bot: New event created: #sticker-swap-2026 — sign-up form: https://forms.gle/FAKEFORM (bot says "I love stickers")

maria: haha, amazing. I'll DM details and acccounts. if you're remote international, we can do digital sticker packs too (PNG/print-friendly).

sam: can we add a rule: no company swag-only packs? let's keep it wild and handmade-friendly.

alex: agreed. plus bonus points for any sticker that makes your laptop look like a tiny chaotic city.

maria: ok that's the vibe. thanks y'all — this is the best non-work thread of my week :sparkles:
